mentions.name: Albedo image dithering toolkit
mentions.description: A toolkit for applying image dithering to stylize album covers, built partly so the author's dithering aesthetic can be replicated later. Finished covers made with it are showcased online, with pixel sorting planned as the next feature.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Slapping together an image dithering toolkit to help with album cover stylization. Partly making sure I can replicate it down the line... but also finding an aesthetic, non-commercial motivation I thought I'd forgotten at work.

Some finished covers (https://saltwatercowboy.github.io/albedo/pages/en-10-05-26.html). Next up pixel sorting.
